node.label: lie and say the shuttle’s battery is broken

links.to_node: The shuttle is not deployed on its scheduled route.
University lab staff believe the shuttle has a battery problem.
The five elementary school students are not hit by loose rocks from the shuttle.
The crossing guard does not face that shuttle approaching the crossing during the students' crossing.
